thread:
Alex: Quick heads-up — noticed ~18% of our eu-west GPU reservation commit is untagged for the last month. Cost spike on billing report. Could be label drift from the nodepool rename last quarter. cc @Sasha

Sasha: On it. Can you paste the bigquery? which reservation id?

Alex: Reservation ID rsv-eu-gpu-23. I ran this quick BQ to surface VM labels tied to reservation:
```sql
SELECT
  labels.key as label_key,
  labels.value as label_value,
  SUM(cost) as total_cost
FROM `billing.gcp_export` b
JOIN `compute.vms` v ON b.resource_id = v.instance_id
WHERE v.reservation = 'rsv-eu-gpu-23' AND usage_start_time >= '2025-11-01'
GROUP BY label_key, label_value
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
```
Result: ~36% of cost rows have label_key = NULL. Rough cost: ~$28k untagged in Nov.

Priya: Oof. If instances were moved between nodepools, labels might have been lost. Retroactive re-labeling is possible for metadata table but doesn't change past billing. We can backfill attribution for internal chargeback via our tag-mapper job.

Jamie: Confirming: reserved NIC-level reservations can't be reattributed in cloud provider billing. But we can create an internal allocation mapping that applies credits and posts adjustments. Also check whether dedicated committed use discounts are zonal vs regional.

Dylan: Short term: run a label-sync job against the instances attached to rsv-eu-gpu-23, and seed cost-allocation with a mapping: reservation -> product-team tag. Steps:
1) run `gcloud compute reservations list --filter="name=rsv-eu-gpu-23"` to capture zone
2) tag VMs with `--update-labels=cost_center=ml-platform` (we already own that) 
3) run backfill: `python infra/tools/tag_backfill.py --reservation rsv-eu-gpu-23 --start 2025-11-01 --end 2025-11-30`

Sasha: I'll run the gcloud check now.

cost-bot: Reservation rsv-eu-gpu-23 utilization 37% over 30 days. Next billing cycle commit auto-renew date: 2026-02-01. :warning:

Alex: Action items:
- Sasha: verify zone and instance list, try label-sync (ETA 2h)
- Priya: prepare mapping for internal chargeback and estimate credits ($28k)
- Jamie: confirm whether CU commitments can be migrated across zones (ETA EOD)
- Dylan: prepare backfill script and dry-run on staging (ETA 1d)

Sasha: Quick update — found two orphaned nodepools (named cortex-legacy-*) that lost labels during automated reprovision. Starting label-sync now, targeting 120 instances. Will post logs.

Alex: thanks. @Priya can we hold auto-renew until we decide split or reassign?

Priya: I'll open a billing hold request with finance and tag the reservation as 'pending-review' in our infra metadata store.

Dylan: I'll also add a temporary allocation mapping to the cost adapter so reporting won't show as 'unallocated' for product dashboards.

Jamie: Also recommend we add a CI check: when nodepool rename occurs, run label-preserve hook. Filing a follow-up PR.
